searchText: Did we finalize a validator<>beacon chain api this is what we have been using, and it's similar to the lighthouse one as well : ) https://api.prylabs.net which is derived from https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/ethereumapis K so I'm going to assume that NO we have NOT finalized an rpc https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/tree/dev/specs/validator there is a swagger d9ocs for validator api yea i dont think we have a finalized rpc version yet I would like to prioritize this .. lets not repeat ETH1.x we have a pretty well documented definition that <@363800010518822915> shared up there. We'd love any feedback https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/ethereumapis will create an issue for this tomorrow... I believe what is in the eth2.0 specs repo is the standard and that multiple clients are working toward it. Beyond that, multiple clients have been extending user APIs and I hope to bring these into https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-apis ^ just migrated the validator api spec to eth2.0-apis the other day to move standardization, convo, and testing there oh ok awesome Part of the survey is to see if clients are using this validator API or not and if any issues yeah we're responding tomorrow .. we all just got to berlin nice! happy jetlag 🙂 🙃 I think it's fair to start spec'ing out a beacon chain API as well absolutely. I am aware of prysm and lighthouse working independently on this effort. From my understanding there is a large overlap in their initial APIs was going to prod people to bring it to the eth2.0-apis repo soon ok greeaat with those two in mind I'll probably kickstart a barebones wrapper that an ethers/web3.js could piggy back off of 👍
